Rules Service and Finlynq use isolated Python 3.12 environments with matching CI setup.

Stable forecast identity, immutable versions, Decimal snapshots, provenance, and additive migrations are complete.
Idempotent generation, input-state hashing, optimistic concurrency, and stable 409 behavior are complete.
Versioned read APIs enforce transitional user scope and preserve historical versions.
Migration rollback, retention, feature flags, security review, and required test evidence are complete.
UI uses persisted forecasts with explainability, accessibility, and parity coverage.
Recommendations link goals, evidence, risks, confidence, approvals, and evaluation.
Decision history, alternatives, outcomes, permissions, auditability, and recovery are tested.

risks.description: Legacy Finance Copilot, WealthIQ, CashFlix, and Finlynq names remain.
risks.mitigation: Track bounded terminology cleanup; avoid broad rename during delivery work.

risks.description: Synthetic fixture directories retain compatibility-oriented names.
risks.mitigation: Keep synthetic labels and manifest; rename only in a dedicated compatibility change.

risks.description: Rules Service and Finlynq require separate FastAPI-pinned environments.
risks.mitigation: Use isolated environments and provision both in CI.

risks.description: The existing Goal.target_amount Float can lose source precision before Phase 1 snapshot normalization.
risks.mitigation: Convert through Decimal(str(value)), record provenance, add boundary tests, and review canonical goal-money migration separately.

risks.description: SQLite and PostgreSQL differ in exact numeric storage and concurrency semantics for immutable forecast versions.
risks.mitigation: Require Decimal round-trip, migration, locking, uniqueness-race, and rollback tests on both supported dialects before rollout.

risks.description: No approved retention or user-deletion policy exists for immutable forecast history.
risks.mitigation: Retain versions without purge or cascade, restrict default-off validation, and block external multi-user production enablement until policy approval.

risks.description: An untrusted generation request could forge canonical financial state or provenance if the trusted adapter boundary regresses.
risks.mitigation: Accept no client financial-state fields, authorize the goal before one trusted adapter invocation, reject unknown fields, and require spoofing and adapter-order tests.
risks.related: ADR-006, issue #3, PR #4, PR #6 (trusted-boundary contract slice)

risks.description: Finlynq active account balances have no authoritative currency attribute; a user preference/default cannot prove balances are USD for atlas-projection-state/v1.
risks.mitigation: Add and independently review an authoritative account-currency source and migration/ingestion policy before enabling the B0 provider.
